g.text: First-principles serving runtimes, memory hierarchy optimization,
continuous batching, and empirical GPU roofline benchmarking.
PEAK FP16: 14.6 TFLOP/s | DRAM BW: 192 GB/s
ROOFLINE DIAGNOSTIC: Decode bound by 192 GB/s DRAM bus.
Prefill saturates Tensor Cores. Sched-Sim mandates chunked prefill + disagg.
PREFIX CACHE SPEEDUP: 4.2× TTFT Reduction (793ms vs 23.5s Cold)
